title: T-RECAP Phase 2 CSR map contract schema
description: Validates the hand-written CSR source-of-truth JSON consumed by the R1 generated-header flow.

const.name: ID
const.description: Numeric little-endian CSR value 0x54524350. Software compares the numeric value, not raw ASCII bytes.

const.name: VERSION
const.description: Transport version packed as VERSION[31:16]=major and VERSION[15:0]=minor. Step 14 appends the explicitly supported command/replay CSR extension as minor 8 while retaining major 1 compatibility.

const.name: CONTROL
const.description: Control register containing persistent levels and write-one pulses.

fields.name: telemetry_enable
fields.description: Persistent level. 1 enables telemetry writer scheduling after ring configuration.

fields.name: telemetry_soft_reset
fields.description: Write-one pulse. Resets telemetry formatter, packet FIFOs, writer FSM, and transport counters.
fields.write_semantics: write 1 generates one pulse; write 0 has no effect

fields.name: clear_metrics
fields.description: Write-one pulse. Requests core metric clear at a safe boundary.
fields.write_semantics: write 1 generates one pulse; write 0 has no effect

fields.name: reserved_3
fields.description: Reserved in Revision G. Sticky flags are cleared only by CLEAR_STICKY_FLAGS.

fields.name: ring_writer_enable
fields.description: Persistent level. Enables DDR ring writes after ring configuration is accepted.

fields.name: reserved_31_5
fields.description: Reserved. Write zero; ignore on read unless a later revision assigns bits.

const.name: STATUS
const.description: Live transport state bits.

fields.name: telemetry_enabled
fields.description: Active telemetry-enable state.

fields.name: ring_writer_enabled
fields.description: Active DDR ring-writer enable state.

fields.name: ring_configured
fields.description: Ring base and size have been committed and accepted.

fields.name: writer_busy
fields.description: DDR writer is actively writing, waiting, or committing a record.

fields.name: core_alive
fields.description: Core/sample activity heartbeat.

fields.name: malformed_config
fields.description: Current ring/control configuration is malformed or not accepted.

fields.name: ring_full
fields.description: Ring has insufficient free space for at least one scheduled telemetry record.

fields.name: packet_fifo_full
fields.description: Telemetry packet FIFO has reached or recently reached full condition.

fields.name: thr2_commit_pending
fields.description: THR2 commit is pending safe-frame application.

fields.name: source_commit_pending
fields.description: A source-mode request is pending safe application or the requested source mode has not yet become the actual source-mux selection.

fields.name: actual_source_mode
fields.description: Actual source-mux selection using the source_mode enumeration. This is active readback, not the requested shadow value.

fields.name: transport_epoch_idle
fields.description: The DDR writer is idle and no telemetry packet is queued for DDR, so a transport command may perform an idle-only operation.

fields.name: source_transition_busy
fields.description: A source discontinuity, source-adapter reset, or safe-boundary source transition is in progress.

fields.name: reserved_31_14
fields.description: Reserved. Shall read as zero unless assigned by a later compatible minor revision.

const.name: THR2_LO
const.description: Shadow threshold bits [31:0].
const.write_semantics: write low word of THR2 shadow

const.name: THR2_HI
const.description: Shadow threshold bits [55:32] in bits [23:0]; upper bits [31:24] shall be zero.
const.write_semantics: write high word of THR2 shadow; reject or flag nonzero upper bits

const.name: THR2_COMMIT
const.description: Writing 1 requests active threshold update at the next frame boundary.
const.write_semantics: write one pulse; active THR2 updates only at safe frame boundary

const.name: PACKET_ENABLE
const.description: Packet-enable bitmask. Spectrum format is selected by SPEC_MODE, not by separate SPEC packet enables.

fields.name: WAVE_EN
fields.description: Enable WAVE telemetry packets.

fields.name: SPEC_EN
fields.description: Enable spectrum telemetry. SPEC_MODE selects SPEC64 or SPEC129.

fields.name: METRICS_EN
fields.description: Enable METRICS telemetry packets.

fields.name: STATUS_EN
fields.description: Enable STATUS telemetry packets.

fields.name: PEAKS_EN
fields.description: Reserved-disabled in Revision G. Commands setting this bit are rejected unless an extension freezes PEAKS.

fields.name: DEBUG_EN
fields.description: Reserved-disabled in Revision G. Commands setting this bit are rejected unless an extension freezes DEBUG.

fields.name: reserved_31_6
fields.description: Reserved. Commands setting these bits are rejected.

const.name: WAVE_DECIM
const.description: Waveform sample decimation factor. Active value is reported as WAVE.stride.

const.name: SPEC_MODE
const.description: Spectrum selector: 0 disabled, 1 SPEC64, 2 SPEC129. Other values are illegal.

const.name: SPEC_SHIFT
const.description: Unsigned right shift before clamping mag2 to uint16_t spectrum display values.

const.name: SOURCE_MODE_SHADOW
const.description: Shadow source mode: 0 BRAM replay, 1 ADC live, 2 audio wrapper, 3 diagnostic source.

const.name: SOURCE_MODE_COMMIT
const.description: Writing 1 requests atomic source-mode update under the source-mode change rule.
const.write_semantics: write one pulse; FPGA applies only at safe sample/frame boundary and resets affected state

const.name: RING_BASE_LO
const.description: FPGA-visible DDR ring base address bits [31:0].

const.name: RING_BASE_HI
const.description: FPGA-visible DDR ring base address bits [63:32], if used by the bridge.

const.name: RING_SIZE_BYTES
const.description: Ring size in bytes. Must be power of two, multiple of 64, and at least 1 MiB.

const.name: RING_CONFIG_COMMIT
const.description: Latches ring base/size into the writer when telemetry is disabled. Resets producer pointer W to zero on accepted commit.
const.write_semantics: write one pulse; accepted only while telemetry disabled

const.name: RING_WR_SNAPSHOT
const.description: HPS writes 1 to request an atomic snapshot of the FPGA-owned producer pointer.

const.name: RING_WR_LO_SNAP
const.description: Latched producer pointer bits [31:0]. Stable until next RING_WR_SNAPSHOT.

const.name: RING_WR_HI_SNAP
const.description: Latched producer pointer bits [63:32]. Stable until next RING_WR_SNAPSHOT.

const.name: RING_RD_LO_SHADOW
const.description: HPS-owned consumer pointer shadow bits [31:0].

const.name: RING_RD_HI_SHADOW
const.description: HPS-owned consumer pointer shadow bits [63:32].

const.name: RING_RD_COMMIT
const.description: Writing 1 makes the shadow consumer pointer visible to the FPGA writer through a CDC-safe commit.
const.write_semantics: write one pulse; do not consume independent low/high updates

const.name: DMA_DROP_COUNT
const.description: Number of telemetry records dropped by the FPGA DDR writer after writer scheduling/free-space acceptance stage.

const.name: DMA_PACKET_COUNT
const.description: Number of normal telemetry records committed to DDR.

const.name: DMA_STATUS
const.description: DDR writer status bits.

fields.name: writer_idle
fields.description: DDR writer FSM is idle.

fields.name: writer_busy
fields.description: DDR writer FSM is processing a record or waiting for write completion.

fields.name: no_space
fields.description: Last attempted record did not fit under the ring free-space rule.

fields.name: malformed_config
fields.description: Base, size, or alignment configuration is invalid.

fields.name: ring_full
fields.description: Ring occupancy has reached the writer full threshold.

fields.name: packet_fifo_full
fields.description: Packet FIFO full condition is active or was recently observed.

fields.name: ddr_wait
fields.description: Writer is blocked by DDR/Avalon waitrequest or equivalent bus backpressure.

fields.name: drop_active
fields.description: A record is currently being dropped or was dropped in the current service interval.

fields.name: reserved_31_8
fields.description: Reserved. Shall read as zero unless assigned by a later revision.

const.name: CORE_COUNT_SNAPSHOT
const.description: HPS writes 1 to latch coherent sample and frame counters into snapshot registers.

const.name: FRAME_COUNT_SNAP_LO
const.description: Latched STFT frame count bits [31:0].

const.name: FRAME_COUNT_SNAP_HI
const.description: Latched STFT frame count bits [63:32].

const.name: SAMPLE_COUNT_SNAP_LO
const.description: Latched core sample count bits [31:0].

const.name: SAMPLE_COUNT_SNAP_HI
const.description: Latched core sample count bits [63:32].

const.name: OVERFLOW_FLAGS
const.description: Sticky overflow/error/status flags.

fields.name: arithmetic_overflow
fields.description: Core arithmetic overflow or unexpected internal range violation observed.

fields.name: ola_overflow
fields.description: OLA accumulator overflow or saturation-risk condition observed.

fields.name: ring_overflow
fields.description: Ring occupancy rule was violated or would have been violated without dropping.

fields.name: packet_fifo_overflow
fields.description: Packet FIFO overflow/drop condition occurred.

fields.name: malformed_packet
fields.description: Malformed DDR record or packet header observed.

fields.name: illegal_command
fields.description: FPGA/CSR-side illegal command or illegal CSR safety request observed.

fields.name: cdc_error
fields.description: CDC protocol violation or invalid snapshot/commit condition detected.

fields.name: threshold_range_error
fields.description: Requested THR2 outside legal 56-bit baseline range.

fields.name: source_mode_error
fields.description: Illegal or unsafe source-mode transition requested.

fields.name: oversized_record
fields.description: Record exceeded Revision G UDP size bound or packet-type maximum.

fields.name: reserved_31_10
fields.description: Reserved. Reads zero. Writes to CLEAR_STICKY_FLAGS reserved bits have no effect.

const.name: CLEAR_STICKY_FLAGS
const.description: Write-one-to-clear mask using the same bit map as OVERFLOW_FLAGS. Reserved-bit writes have no effect.

fields.name: arithmetic_overflow
fields.description: Core arithmetic overflow or unexpected internal range violation observed.

fields.name: ola_overflow
fields.description: OLA accumulator overflow or saturation-risk condition observed.

fields.name: ring_overflow
fields.description: Ring occupancy rule was violated or would have been violated without dropping.

fields.name: packet_fifo_overflow
fields.description: Packet FIFO overflow/drop condition occurred.

fields.name: malformed_packet
fields.description: Malformed DDR record or packet header observed.

fields.name: illegal_command
fields.description: FPGA/CSR-side illegal command or illegal CSR safety request observed.

fields.name: cdc_error
fields.description: CDC protocol violation or invalid snapshot/commit condition detected.

fields.name: threshold_range_error
fields.description: Requested THR2 outside legal 56-bit baseline range.

fields.name: source_mode_error
fields.description: Illegal or unsafe source-mode transition requested.

fields.name: oversized_record
fields.description: Record exceeded Revision G UDP size bound or packet-type maximum.

fields.name: reserved_31_10
fields.description: Reserved. Reads zero. Writes to CLEAR_STICKY_FLAGS reserved bits have no effect.

const.write_semantics: write 1 clears matching sticky flag bit; write 0 leaves bit unchanged

const.name: CSR_COMMAND_REJECT_COUNT
const.description: Number of command or state-change requests rejected by FPGA/CSR safety logic after HPS validation.

const.name: PACKET_FIFO_DROP_COUNT
const.description: Pre-writer telemetry tap or packet-FIFO drop count. Distinct from DMA_DROP_COUNT.

const.name: COUNTER_CLEAR
const.description: Step-14 write-one-pulse control for clearing FPGA-owned transport diagnostic counters without resetting active transport state.

fields.name: transport_counters
fields.description: Clear DMA_DROP_COUNT, DMA_PACKET_COUNT, CSR_COMMAND_REJECT_COUNT, and PACKET_FIFO_DROP_COUNT. Preserve producer W, consumer Rd, normal telemetry sequence state, core sample/frame counters, ring configuration, control levels, sticky flags, and replay state.
fields.write_semantics: write 1 emits one clear pulse; write 0 has no effect

fields.name: reserved_31_1
fields.description: Reserved. Software shall write zero.

const.write_semantics: Only bit 0 is legal. Counter clear is diagnostic-only and shall not reset or reconfigure the transport.

const.name: REPLAY_CONTROL
const.description: Step-14 replay command pulses routed through the existing BRAM-replay request, admission, and retained-result authority.

fields.name: start
fields.description: Issue one raw BRAM-replay start request. The request shall pass through the existing Step-11 admission logic and shall never bypass readiness checks.
fields.write_semantics: write 1 emits one raw start-request pulse; acceptance or rejection is retained in REPLAY_STATUS

fields.name: rearm
fields.description: Rearm a quiescent failed replay epoch and clear its retained replay result state while preserving committed transport W, Rd, packet sequence, ring configuration, and transport counters.
fields.write_semantics: write 1 emits one replay-only rearm pulse; software waits for start_ready before a later start write

fields.name: reserved_31_2
fields.description: Reserved. Software shall write zero.

const.write_semantics: START and REARM are separate write-one-pulse operations and shall not be asserted in the same CSR write.

const.name: REPLAY_STATUS
const.description: Live and retained BRAM-replay command/result state. HPS snapshots result_epoch before START and waits for a modulo-2^16 epoch change with exactly one retained terminal result.

fields.name: pending
fields.description: A raw START request has been captured and its admission decision has not yet been retained.

fields.name: last_accept
fields.description: Retained terminal result for the most recently decided START request was accepted. Mutually exclusive with last_reject.

fields.name: last_reject
fields.description: Retained terminal result for the most recently decided START request was rejected by replay admission. Mutually exclusive with last_accept.

fields.name: start_ready
fields.description: Current Step-11 replay admission prerequisites are satisfied for a new raw START request.

fields.name: replay_active
fields.description: The BRAM replay source is actively presenting its input or required zero-tail tokens.

fields.name: replay_path_busy
fields.description: The source-through-core replay path epoch is in progress.

fields.name: replay_path_done
fields.description: Retained Step-11 source-through-core path completion evidence for the current or most recent accepted epoch.

fields.name: e2e_busy
fields.description: The stronger replay-through-telemetry-to-DDR completion epoch is in progress.

fields.name: e2e_done
fields.description: Retained Step-11 end-to-end replay completion evidence for the current or most recent accepted epoch.

fields.name: error
fields.description: A replay source, core-path, admission, telemetry, or end-to-end error is retained for the current or most recent replay epoch.

fields.name: rearm_required
fields.description: A failed accepted replay epoch is latched and blocks restart until REPLAY_CONTROL.rearm or reset succeeds.

fields.name: reserved_15_11
fields.description: Reserved. Shall read as zero.

fields.name: result_epoch
fields.description: Modulo-2^16 terminal START-decision epoch. Increment exactly once when a captured START becomes last_accept or last_reject; do not increment on REARM.

x-trecap-semantic-checks: register offsets are sorted, unique, and 32-bit aligned
field lsb shall be less than or equal to msb
fields within one register shall not overlap except documented reserved ranges
complete legacy register objects at offsets 0x000 through 0x088 shall match the executable semantic SHA-256 snapshot
reserved and reserved-disabled fields shall not be emitted as writable enables
multiword controls shall be emitted as snapshot or shadow/commit helpers, not live low/high transfers
